version_rule: The program's own version in the shape #.###.# : milestones closed, then the pass number in three digits, then the revision within that pass. 0.004.2 is no milestone closed, pass four, second revision. It moves on every graded unit, every apply and every republish, and the same number appears on the control surface, every published page, PROGRESS.md and the thread update.

continuous.rule: Only the principal sets this, in their own words about this program, with a link to the message. The framer never writes it. commanded false means one pass per invocation. An event trigger needs commanded true too.

rule: Builders may change only the passes field, from false to true, and set proof_ref, after the named proof exists. Builders never write the evaluation object. It is unacceptable to remove, reword, reorder, or add a unit here without a plan change recorded in change_log and on the program thread. Verification steps are never edited by the builder.

change_log.thread_ref: {{link to the program thread post made in the same pass}}

estimate_rule: Every unit is estimated in hours at framing time. The actual is written to control/effort.json when the unit closes, from evidence and never from recollection. After ten closed units the remaining frame is re-estimated from the measured pattern, the old numbers are kept beside the new ones in estimate_history, and the direction of the drift is said plainly.

units.title: {{one verifiable thing}}

estimate.basis: {{what this was estimated from: a comparable closed unit, a guess, a measured pattern}}

proof.method: {{how it is observed: fetch, byte compare, read back, screenshot, test run, render and inspect}}

units.passes_meaning: The builder's own proof exists. This is a self-graded claim and is never independent verification.

evaluation.rule: Written only by an evaluator context that did not build this unit, against evaluator/checks.json, which the builder never reads. A unit with passes true and outcome fail is a held-out gap and is counted at every close.

held_out_gap_rule: At every close, report units where passes is true and evaluation.outcome is fail, as a count of the verified denominator. Never fold that count into passes.
